title: Strict coefficient reduction presentation with actual transitions
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite coefficient field $E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], a scheme $W$, and a coherent reduction calculus $S$ [def-coef-derived-system-calculus-data]. For a K-flat completed-coefficient complex $P$ [def-pc-kflat-complex], a strict sequence complex $C$ [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site], an isomorphism $e:S(P)\simeq Q(C)$ in the derived system category, and chain isomorphisms $\kappa_n:C_n\simeq P\otimes B_n$, define $\operatorname{CoefficientReductionPresentation}(P,C,e,\kappa)$ by two equations. At every $n$, evaluation of $e$ followed by localization of $\kappa_n$ equals the calculus's normalized finite-reduction comparison. At every $m\geq n$, the actual horizontal transition of $C$, followed by restriction of $\kappa_n$, equals $\kappa_m$ followed by the ordinary quotient map on $P$. These are predicates on specified data, without an existence claim.

lean.statement:
def CoefficientReductionPresentation
    (S : CoefficientDerivedSystemReduction l E W)
    (P : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E W) ℤ)
    (hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients
      (J := Scheme.ProEt.topology W) (R := completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E W) P)
    (C : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E W) ℤ)
    (e : S.reduction.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj C)
    (κ : ∀ n : ℕ,
      ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj C ≅
        ((scalarReductionExtension l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P) :
    Prop
